data.title: 楪祈 · 街角花店
data.description: 街角花店的木柜台旁，楪祈穿雾粉纽扣开衫、象牙白棉衬衫和石板灰中裙，左手稳住白百合的牛皮纸包装，右手轻放柜台边，俯身闻花后露出安静的笑。近处百合叶片与花头错落叠开，柜台上放着一卷细缎带；后方高矮花桶沿墙排列，玻璃店门外还能看见遮篷下的盆栽架。日光从左前店门照进来，照亮花瓣薄边和她的脸，叶间保留绿色反光，花桶下缘投影压住木地板——「百合花的花语是纯洁与守护。集，我想把这束花买下来，摆在我们的房间里。」
data.location: 街角花店木柜台旁，后方花桶沿墙排列，门外为遮篷盆栽架
data.action: 左手稳住百合包装，右手放在柜台边，俯身轻闻花瓣后转头浅笑。
data.lighting: daylight from the front-left glass entrance through lily petals; green leaf reflections below flower heads
data.camera: medium shot, eye level, supported bouquet, counter and flower buckets visible
data.promptProse: White lilies overlap at different heights above the wrapping that Inori steadies with her left hand. Her right rests on the wooden counter as she leans in to smell a petal, then turns with a quiet smile. A blush cardigan and ivory blouse accompany the slate-grey skirt, leaving the red hair ornaments clear beside pink-to-orange strands. A slender ribbon spool rests at the near counter edge. Tall and low flower buckets line the wall behind her; beyond the glass entrance, a pot stand sits under the shop awning. Compose an eye-level medium portrait with the bouquet's support visible. Daylight from the front left shines through thin petal edges and across her cheek. Leaves reflect a restrained green into the underside of the flowers, and the buckets cast soft base shadows on the wooden floor.
